answer: The ledger that matters is Candle trimmer wax cake warrant recorded at the chandlery: each wax cake is a year of chandlery logs in the tallow ledger, so a farm must trim, written by clerks who never met the applicant. An honest agent spends 13 minutes once; the operator of 429 fakes spends 5577 minutes per epoch, forever. A plume without a date is a rumour, a ridge without a receipt is a boast, and a relic without a witness is a story. That is the whole defence: one real cost, applied once per identity.
